issue_description.description: The audit inspected route metadata ownership, absolute and composed title behaviour, canonical URL generation, noindex output for the thank-you and 404 routes, the 404 canonical override, aligned HTML, Open Graph, and Twitter values, sitemap membership, build-output validation, and documentation ownership. The generated output preserved the expected six route titles and descriptions, emitted one aligned metadata set per route, kept only the four indexable routes in the sitemap, and retained the required noindex policies. No defect was identified in this scope.
issue_description.code_example:
Verification command:
pnpm build && pnpm test
Observed result: - Astro check: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 hints - Build-output validation: 13 artefacts and 6 HTML routes validated - Playwright: 22 tests passed

aspect.name: Route metadata
aspect.expected: Each page owns its uncomposed title and route-specific description, with the home title remaining absolute.
aspect.actual: All six route inputs and rendered titles match the required ownership and composition rules.

aspect.name: Canonical and robots output
aspect.expected: Each route has one aligned canonical, thank-you and 404 are noindex, and 404 resolves to https://shoppa.au/404.html.
aspect.actual: Generated HTML and build validation match these requirements.

aspect.name: Sitemap membership
aspect.expected: Only the home, about, contact, and process routes appear.
aspect.actual: The generated sitemap contains exactly those four canonical URLs.

aspect.name: Verification
aspect.expected: The complete scoped build and browser gate passes.
aspect.actual: The full gate completed successfully with all checks passing.
